description: This file contains hooks and utility functions for customizing and extending MkDocs documentation build process, including handling localization, resolving files, and modifying navigation and page content.

classes.name: EnFile
classes.description: A subclass of mkdocs.structure.files.File, potentially for extension or customization specific to this project.

methods.name: str get_missing_translation_content(docs_dir: str)
methods.description: Reads and returns the content of 'missing-translation.md' from the parent directories.

methods.name: list[str] get_mkdocs_material_langs()
methods.description: Returns a list of available language codes based on HTML files in the material theme.

methods.name: MkDocsConfig on_config(config: MkDocsConfig, **kwargs: Any)
methods.description: Adjusts configuration options such as language and site URL based on directory structure and available languages.

methods.name: None resolve_file(*, item: str, files: Files, config: MkDocsConfig)
methods.description: Resolves and appends a file to the files list, looking for English fallback if not found.

methods.name: None resolve_files(*, items: list[Any], files: Files, config: MkDocsConfig)
methods.description: Processes a list of items, resolving each related file.

methods.name: Files on_files(files: Files, *, config: MkDocsConfig)
methods.description: Handles the files processing stage, resolving static assets and other references.

methods.name: list[Union[Page,Section,Link]] generate_renamed_section_items( items: list[Union[Page, Section, Link]], *, config: MkDocsConfig )
methods.description: Recursively processes navigation sections to potentially update titles based on the first page.

methods.name: Navigation on_nav( nav: Navigation, *, config: MkDocsConfig, files: Files, **kwargs: Any )
Page on_pre_page(page: Page, *, config: MkDocsConfig, files: Files)
methods.description: Hook called before page processing, currently a placeholder returning the page unchanged.

methods.name: str on_page_markdown( markdown: str, *, page: Page, config: MkDocsConfig, files: Files )
methods.description: Modifies page markdown content, especially to indicate translation status and handle missing translations.
